pr.title: [codex] route image requests by capability
pr.body:
## Summary

- remove legacy provider group surfaces in favor of provider key groups
- route explicit image-generation requests through image-capable candidates only
- add provider key `capabilities` storage, cache, API, and admin UI support for `image_generation`
- allow Responses `image_generation_call` through canonical image conversion instead of treating it as an unsupported custom tool item

## Why

Image-generation traffic could be scheduled onto ordinary chat keys/endpoints, which can surface upstream 403 errors. The scheduler now requires both the global model and provider key to explicitly support `image_generation` before selecting image endpoints.

## Validation

- `cargo fmt --check`
- `timeout 60 cargo test -p hook_backend matching_candidate_parts_requires`
- `timeout 60 cargo test -p hook_backend matching_candidate_parts_routes`
- `timeout 300 cargo check -p hook_backend`
- `pnpm lint:frontend`

## Commits included

- `5d4fa532 refactor: 移除提供商分组`
- `e4845379 fix: route image requests by capability`
